data.name: Function.Agents.TemplateManagement.Description
data.value: Create or edit AgentTemplates. When composing a ChatGroup, first use “Search Agent templates” and prefer enabled templates whose responsibilities fit the task; create a new Agent only when existing templates are insufficient. A new Agent may use a plain-text System Prompt. The result includes its Agent ID; pass that ID through “Members (manual input)” in “Manage ChatGroup” to add the new Agent.

data.name: Function.Agents.SearchTemplate.Name
data.value: Search Agent templates and return IDs

data.name: Function.Agents.SearchTemplate.Description
data.value: Before creating an AgentTemplate or ChatGroup, search existing AgentTemplates by name, responsibility keywords, or PromptCode and return matching options. Prefer enabled templates that fit the task; supports multiple keywords.

data.name: Function.Agents.SearchChatGroup.Description
data.value: Before creating a ChatGroup, search existing groups by name or use-case keywords. Return at most 10 matches with IDs, descriptions, and members. Always inspect and reuse a suitable existing group; do not create a duplicate based on name alone.

data.name: Function.Agents.ManageChatGroup.Description
data.value: Search for and prefer existing AgentTemplates whose responsibilities fit the task, then call “Search ChatGroups” with task keywords and reuse a group whose name, use case, and members fit. Create an AgentTemplate with a plain-text System Prompt only when existing Agents are insufficient; if the new Agent is absent from the member options, pass its ID through “Members (manual input)”. Only if no suitable ChatGroup exists, explain the proposed group name, Agents, and use case to the user and wait for explicit confirmation before selecting “New group”. A use case is required; the system adds the [AdminChat:AutoGenerated] marker to the description.

data.name: Function.Agents.StartChatGroup.Description
data.value: Start an existing ChatGroup suitable for the task. Check existing groups and obtain explicit user confirmation before creating a new one.
